item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=computational+boundaries+persistent+identity+memory+persistence+philosophy+of+mind&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1093/oso/9780190867614.003.0018\", \"title\": [\"Outliving Oneself\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>\\n               <jats:p>This chapter explores the intersection between trauma, memory, and personal identity in developing a feminist account of the relational self. On this view the self is both autonomous and socially dependent, vulnerable enough to be undone by violence and yet resilient enough to be reconstructed with the help of empathic others. When trauma victims’ experiences are acknowledged to be theoretically relevant, the sense of self that emerges highlights the embodied nature of self as a person’s bodily sense of self is fundamentally altered by trauma. This chapter argues that recovery of the sense of self is possible through the construction of a narrative of the trauma endured and the sharing of one’s story with understanding listeners. Through relationships with others, survivors of trauma create meaning and remake themselves, paradoxically becoming more autonomous by building social bonds of care and dependency.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1093/oso/9780190867614.003.0018\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2022, 7, 7]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.4324/9780429508127-11\", \"title\": [\"The boundaries of the mind 1\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.4324/9780429508127-11\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2018, 7, 6]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.4324/9780429508219-2\", \"title\": [\"Presocratic interest in the soul’s persistence after death\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.4324/9780429508219-2\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2018, 7, 6]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.4135/9781412979306.n175\", \"title\": [\"Persistence, Termination, and Memory\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.4135/9781412979306.n175\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2010]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "186be9d8bdec2c732afa0b48e331c353ec287caad07af1af6e4a1eafeed83cb6", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "memory_and_identity", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": …
